purpose: AP01-R4 / AP01-V2-04: for each scenario category the Controller Lab CLI cannot express, record what existing host/pipeline/Level4 code was found, HOW STRONG that finding is, and what remains uncovered.

evidence_levels.FILE_EXISTS: the file was located in the repository; its content was not read in this session
evidence_levels.READ_IN_THIS_SESSION: the file (or the cited region) was read in this session; the description below reflects what the source and its own comments say
evidence_levels.EXECUTED_IN_THIS_SESSION: the suite was compiled and run in this session and its result observed

scope_statement: REV3 correction (AP01-V2-04). NOTHING in this inventory is at EXECUTED_IN_THIS_SESSION. No existing host suite was compiled or run during AP-01. Reading a test file shows what it INTENDS to assert; it does not establish that the assertion currently passes, nor that the property holds for the full assist chain. REV2 wrongly wrote 'correctness already proven exhaustively', 'does not need new evidence' and 'proof already complete' on the strength of reading alone. Those claims are withdrawn. Where a file's own header claims exhaustiveness, that is reported as the file's claim about its own module, not as a verified property of the pipeline.
note_on_flag_syntax: controller_lab.c parses key=value arguments (parse_arg, KEY(name) over 'arg=value'). All extension proposals use key=value. No CLI change is made in this rework; the shared harness stays READ_ONLY.

csv_emitting_harnesses.correction: REV2 claimed Controller Lab is the only harness producing a metrics.py-consumable CSV. That is FALSE and is withdrawn.

found.significance: Carries iq_actual, motor_erps and u_abs - precisely the channels Controller Lab cannot provide (u_abs and battery current are fixed at zero there). Any future need for actual/bridge-side channels should start from this harness, not from a Controller Lab extension. Not exercised in AP-01.

Replays a recorded sensor history through production C and emits new-vs-recorded deltas. sim/replay/cases/ currently contains only README.md, i.e. zero registered real-ride cases, so this path has no recorded input to replay today.
Existing consumer of the Level-4 trace CSV (reads iq_request/iq_ref/iq_actual/motor_erps/u_abs). Relevant prior art if AP-01 metrics are ever applied to L4 traces.

categories.extension_needed: controller_lab.c: miss_tick_every_n=<int>. BLOCKED on a design decision first - see clock_separation_note.
categories.clock_separation_note: controller_lab.c runs a fixed CTRL_HZ=4000 loop and does not model the sensor/PAS timebase, the 4 kHz foreground and the 16 kHz FOC ISR as independently schedulable clocks the way main.c's interrupt structure does. A skip injected in the harness's outer loop would stop ALL of them together, which is not what a missed foreground tick means on the target: the ISR would still have run. Which clock the skip applies to must be decided before implementation, or the resulting numbers will describe a stall that cannot occur.

existing_coverage.not_covered: Unit scope, not executed here, no Iq series.
